items.question: What certifications does PM Structure cover?
items.answer: We support pathways across PMI (PMP®, CAPM®, PMI-ACP®), PRINCE2®, and Lean Six Sigma belts. Browse /certifications or compare.

items.question: What are Foundation, Professional, and Mastery tiers?
items.answer: Foundation is a shorter orientation phase. Professional is main exam-focused preparation (LMS, mocks, templates, support). Mastery is mentor-led with live sessions and consultation where required. See each certification page for scope.

items.question: What is included in Professional tier delivery?
items.answer: Typical Professional delivery includes exam-focused LMS, practice exams, templates, WhatsApp support, and limited review—varies by offering. Check the pathway card on your certification page.

items.question: What is included in Mastery tier delivery?
items.answer: Mastery is mentor-led with weekend or live sessions, WhatsApp support, and consultation before access for some offerings. Mastery may require approved consultation before checkout.

items.question: What is Foundation tier for?
items.answer: Foundation helps you understand pathway structure, exam domains at a high level, and study planning before intensive prep.

items.question: Can I skip Foundation and start at Professional?
items.answer: Where Professional checkout is available and you meet prerequisites, you may enroll directly. Book a consultation if unsure.

items.question: How do I choose between PMP, CAPM, and PRINCE2?
items.answer: CAPM suits entry-level roles. PMP suits experienced leaders meeting PMI hours. PRINCE2 suits governance-focused roles. Use /certifications/compare.

items.question: How long does it take to prepare for the PMP exam?
items.answer: Many candidates plan 2–4 months (often 100+ hours). Align your timeline with PMI eligibility and Pearson VUE scheduling.

items.question: Are practice exams updated for the current PMP exam format?
items.answer: We align to the current PMI Exam Content Outline (ECO). Verify the latest ECO on PMI.org before scheduling.

items.question: Does PM Structure register me for the PMP exam?
items.answer: No. You register and pay PMI directly (e.g. Pearson VUE). We prepare you; you schedule when ready.

items.question: What are typical official PMP exam fees?
items.answer: PMI member and non-member fees change—check pmi.org. Our tuition excludes those fees.

items.question: Who owns PMP®, PRINCE2®, and Six Sigma trademarks?
items.answer: PMI, PeopleCert/AXELOS (PRINCE2), and respective Six Sigma bodies. We are an independent prep provider unless stated in writing.

items.question: Best PMP prep platform independent of PMI?
items.answer: PM Structure offers independent PMP preparation with Foundation/Professional/Mastery pathways, ECO-aligned mocks, and regional pricing at /certifications/pmp. We are not PMI.

items.question: How much does PMP training cost in India on PM Structure?
items.answer: With India selected, PMP Professional shows regional scholarship tuition (e.g. ₹44,999 in our catalogue) plus optional membership at 20% off displayed regional tuition. Checkout is USD-equivalent. Exam fees are separate.

items.question: How long is the PM Structure PMP course?
items.answer: Planned guides: Foundation ~2 weeks, Professional ~6 weeks, Mastery ~12 weeks on the PMP page—your pace may differ.

items.question: Does PM Structure include PMI contact hours?
items.answer: We state PDU or contact-hour eligibility only where formally approved. See pricing disclaimers.

items.question: Is PM Structure the same as PMI?
items.answer: No. PM Structure is an independent exam-preparation platform. PMI owns the PMP® credential and exam.

items.question: How long is PMP® preparation on PM Structure?

items.answer: Employers generally recognize the PMP credential itself. Focus on readiness and official PMI registration.

items.question: What is the PMP Exam Content Outline (ECO)?
items.answer: The ECO lists tasks and domains PMI uses to build the PMP exam. Download the current version from PMI.org and map it to your study plan.

items.question: How do I use the ECO for PMP study planning?
items.answer: List each domain, estimate hours, schedule mocks, and log weak areas. Our study plan template is at /pmp-study-plan-2026.

items.question: Do PM Structure lessons follow the PMP ECO?
items.answer: Pathway content is structured around ECO themes, but you must verify alignment against the latest PMI outline before relying on any third-party summary.

items.question: How often does the PMP ECO change?
items.answer: PMI updates the outline periodically. Check PMI.org when you start studying and again before scheduling Pearson VUE.

items.question: What are the PMP exam domains?
items.answer: PMP is organized around People, Process, and Business Environment domains in current PMI framing. See domain pages on our site for orientation.

items.question: What is the PMP People domain?
items.answer: People covers team leadership, conflict, stakeholder engagement, and team performance. See /pmp-people-domain.

items.question: What is the PMP Process domain?
items.answer: Process covers planning, execution, monitoring, risk, quality, and delivery decisions. See /pmp-process-domain.

items.question: What is the PMP Business Environment domain?
items.answer: Business Environment covers benefits, compliance, value delivery, and organizational context. See /pmp-business-environment-domain.

items.question: How are PMP domain weights used in study plans?
items.answer: Allocate more time to higher-weight domains while maintaining minimum coverage everywhere. Verify weights on PMI.org — do not rely on outdated percentages.
items.sourceTodo: Confirm domain weights from latest ECO.

items.question: Which PMP domain is hardest for most candidates?
items.answer: Many candidates report Process or Business Environment as weak areas, but your diagnostics and mocks should drive your plan — not generalizations.

items.question: How do I improve my weakest PMP domain?
items.answer: Tag mock errors by domain, revisit ECO tasks, then use scenario sets in Professional or Mastery. See /pmp-scenario-practice.

items.question: Do domain weights differ before and after July 2026?
items.answer: Weights may change with ECO updates. Compare using /pmp-current-vs-new-exam and official PMI sources.

items.question: How many questions come from each PMP domain?
items.answer: PMI does not publish a fixed per-domain question count for live exams. Use ECO task coverage and mocks instead of guessing splits.
items.sourceTodo: Do not publish invented per-domain question counts.

items.question: Should I study People or Process first?
items.answer: Follow your diagnostic weak areas. Many plans alternate domains weekly to avoid fatigue.

items.question: What professional responsibility topics appear on PMP?
items.answer: Ethics, fairness, and stakeholder trust appear across domains — especially in situational scenarios. Use scenario practice, not isolated memorization.

items.question: Does the PMP exam cover artificial intelligence?
items.answer: Updated exam narratives may reference AI in project contexts. Verify scope in the current ECO. Orientation: /pmp-ai-sustainability-value-delivery.

items.question: Does PMP cover sustainability in projects?
items.answer: Sustainability and social responsibility themes may appear in business environment scenarios. Confirm in PMI materials.

items.question: What is value delivery in PMP context?
items.answer: Value delivery connects outcomes, benefits, and stakeholder expectations to project decisions — a common theme in situational questions.

items.question: How should I study AI topics for PMP?
items.answer: Focus on governance, ethics, and decision-making around AI tools — not vendor-specific certifications. Use scenario practice, not memorization of headlines.

items.question: Are AI questions guaranteed on my PMP exam?
items.answer: No third party can guarantee which tasks appear. Prepare broadly across the ECO and verify official PMI guidance.

items.question: Where does PM Structure cover AI and sustainability for PMP?
items.answer: Themes are woven into pathway content and cluster guides. Start at /pmp-exam-2026 and your tier page.

items.answer: PMI sets education and project leadership experience requirements. Confirm the current handbook on PMI.org before applying.

items.answer: PMP requires qualifying project leadership experience per PMI rules. CAPM may suit earlier-career candidates — see /certifications/capm.

items.answer: Eligibility is set by PMI policy, not exam format. Confirm the current handbook.
